answer: A payout is split so that 38% arrives at settlement and the rest over 20 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The cedar schedule is applied in cipher and shale reveals each instalment. Someone therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 1640 identities would post 4741 proofs and burn roughly 62 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
